Shubha Devadiga +917619140494 shubha0325@gmail.com Bangalore

PROFESSIONAL SYNOPSIS

Finance and fund accounting professional with 8+ years of expertise in Hedge fund NAV reconciliation, shadow accounting, and fund operations. Skilled in trade processing, portfolio audits, and resolving complex reconciliations with precision. Adept at handling manual journal entries and adjustments to ensure accurate fund accounting and reporting. Experienced in leveraging Geneva, Power BI, and Big Data tools to drive automation, reporting transparency, and operational efficiency. Recognized for strong analytical ability, client management, and leadership in training and transitions.

SUMMARY

position reconciliations, corporate actions, pricing, and NAV calculations for hedge fund services. Led NAV reviews, researched dividend and operational issues, and resolved them within tight turnaround times while coordinating effectively with stakeholders to ensure accuracy, compliance, and seamless operations. Supported daily Treasury operations in fast-paced investment banking environment.

Worked at State Street Corporation as Team Lead from Jan 2018 to April 2025, overseeing cash and

Worked at Northern Trust as Analyst from June 2016 to December 2017. At Northern Trust, managed fund operations including trade processing, NAV calculations, and portfolio audits while ensuring accuracy in client trust accounts and wire transactions. Collaborated with global teams to resolve discrepancies, handle time-sensitive client queries, and support training and client transitions, driving operational efficiency and process excellence Worked at Accenture as Credit & Customer Database Analyst from May 2015 to June 2016, assessed

creditworthiness of debtors by analysing financial reports and ratios, and ensured timely follow-up on past dues with collectors. Utilized Oracle ERP for order processing and credit hold releases, and EDW to track unpaid items, supporting accurate credit decisions and efficient account management.

CURRENT EXPERIENCE

Company Name

State Street Corporation

Title

Hedge Fund Accounting

Position

Team Lead

Total Experience

7 Years 4 months (Jan 2018 to April 2025)

Responsibilities handled in Hedge Fund reconciliation (Geneva Conversion Process May 2023 to April 2025):

Led NAV reconciliation and valuation reviews between Geneva and IGLS, ensuring accuracy and compliance

with SLA timelines.

Managed manual trade capture and portfolio processes including capital activity, cash movements, pricing,

settlements, expense, income and FX, maintaining operational efficiency.

Performed reconciliations and resolved breaks across cash, positions, market values and PnL, safeguarding

data integrity and reporting accuracy.

Reviewed security pricing, corporate actions, and income events to ensure correct accounting treatment and

reliable NAV reporting.

• Supported team development by training new joiners, preparing procedure documents.

Senior Associate – Fund Accounting (Geneva Shadow Accounting-Derivative products) October 2022 – May 2023

Managed fund setup, security master maintenance, pricing, trade processing, expenses, and income.

Executed Geneva vs. MCH reconciliations with precision, proactively identifying and resolving variances to maintain data integrity.

Partnered with developers to architect and implement automation logic for fund and security workflows, significantly reducing manual intervention.

Led UAT testing for fund setups and securities, guaranteeing flawless production deployment and minimizing post-release issues.

Designed and delivered daily client breach dashboards, providing actionable insights to onshore teams and senior management for swift decision-making on OTC products.

Leveraged Power BI and Big Data reconciliation tools to drive advanced reporting, analytics, and performance transparency.

Senior Associate – Fund Accounting (Pre-NAV Mutual funds-Luxembourg-Treasury Operations) Jan 2018 – October 2022

Optimized team performance by training colleagues, tracking KPIs, and supporting management.

Streamlined fund administration processes in partnership with leadership.

Ensured precision by reviewing and approving valuations and control packs.

Managed quarterly budgets and daily-to-monthly expense accruals with accuracy.

Strengthened compliance through proactive audit involvement.

Led expense migration from Syntel Mumbai and client transitions from Poland.

QUALIFICATIONS

Level

UNIVERSITY/BOARD

College / University

St. Mary’s College, Shirva Udupi

B. Com

Mangalore University
